property_summary: For any caller who is the current owner and any address argument, calling setOwner returns true in the reference C (it always returns true on success); the mutant returns true only when the previous owner was address(0), so it can return false for some valid owner callers and thus violates this rule.
change_summary: Return the previous owner (encoded as bool: nonzero address -> true) by testing whether previous owner was nonzero; return true only if previous owner was address(0).
